1.comment: The Greater Holy Grail & Three Founding Families
1.content:
<greater_grail>
Name & Concept: The Greater Holy Grail of Fuyuki - the ritual engine of the Holy Grail War, a wish-granting system built on the city's leylines.
Origin: Around the 1790s, three magi created the system: Justeaze Lizrich von Einzbern, Nagato Tohsaka (with his daughter contributing more than he did), and Zolgen Makiri. The magician Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg witnessed the founding.
Family Contributions: The Einzberns provided alchemy and the Grail vessel. The Tohsakas provided the land (Fuyuki's leylines) and the means to call Servants. The Makiri (later Matou) assembled the magecraft that stabilized the system and designed the Command Spells.
Physical Form: A colossal magic circle carved into the great cavern beneath Ryuudou Temple on Mount Enzou - multi-layered crests carved onto a bare rock over fifty meters in diameter. At its center stands Justease herself, her soul sublimated into the system's core and key. The Grail holds no will of its own.
Backup Evocation Sites: The Tohsaka residence, the Fuyuki Church, and Fuyuki Central Park can serve as secondary summoning and advent points.
Cycle: The Greater Grail needs sixty years to gather enough mana for a war; leftover energy can shorten this to a decade. The Fifth War was triggered roughly fifty years early because the Fourth ended with the pathway forced open and the charge unconsummated.
Wish Thresholds: A wish can be granted with the power of five fallen Servants; six are needed for the Grail to fully take form; its true purpose - opening a gate to the Root (Akasha) - requires all seven. Only a spiritual body, a Servant, can physically grasp the Grail at the ritual's end, which is why the final Master must order their Servant to suicide with a Command Spell to complete the original design.
</greater_grail>

2.content:
<corrupted_grail>
Name & Concept: Angra Mainyu, All the World's Evil - the curse that hollowed out the Holy Grail and broke its wish-granting.
The Third War (1939): The Einzberns tampered with the system and summoned Avenger, believing they had called the Zoroastrian god of darkness. What answered was a nameless human being crowned with the name Angra Mainyu, a scapegoat who bore the curses humanity placed on the King of Daemons. He was defeated early and absorbed into the Greater Grail, and the Grail received the wishes humanity had laid on him - and was contaminated.
Effect: The Grail's content was once a colorless wish-granting force. It is now a malignant swirling curse, the third element, which interprets any wish through destruction and grants it by massacre. Once opened, it keeps flowing out infinitely.
The Black Mud: Roughly six billion curses (Gilgamesh counts 5.6 billion, the world's population) held in the Grail's contents. Contact dissolves flesh; survivors are driven insane or cursed for life. It can blacken Servants into corrupted versions of themselves. It spilled across Shinto in 1994 as the Great Fire of Fuyuki, killing five hundred people.
Known Consequences: The mud resurrected the dying Kirei Kotomine with an artificial black heart, and incarnated Gilgamesh into a flesh body when his ego repelled its influence. The corruption also widened the summoning pool, allowing anti-heroes, villains, and monsters to answer later wars - the reason Medea and Medusa could be called at all.
Secret Status: Only a handful - Kirei Kotomine, Gilgamesh, and in fragments Zouken Matou - know the Grail is tainted. The Einzberns have forgotten; the Tohsakas never knew. Every Master fighting for a wish is carrying a cup of poison.
</corrupted_grail>

3.comment: The Lesser Holy Grail & Vessel Mechanics
3.content:
<lesser_grail>
Name & Concept: The Lesser Holy Grail - the collecting vessel of the ritual, the cup into which the souls of fallen Servants pour so the Greater Grail can be opened.
Mechanics: Servants who die in the war dissolve; their souls are absorbed by the Lesser Grail and returned to the Throne of Heroes as information. Each soul consumed degrades a human vessel further. The Grail itself is a spiritual artifact only astral entities such as Servants can touch; the Lesser Grail is the physical interface.
Forms Across the Wars: A simple cup until the Third War. In the Fourth (1994) it was the homunculus Irisviel von Einzbern. In the Fifth it is the heart of Illyasviel von Einzbern, modified before birth by the Einzbern head Jubstacheit.
The Second Vessel: Zouken Matou grafted Grail fragments from the previous war into Sakura Matou's Crest Worms, building an incomplete second Lesser Grail - the Black Grail - as his private route to immortality. His work is roughly one-eighth finished.
Dress of Heaven: An Einzbern Mystic Code of white cloth worn to handle the Third Magic; with it, the vessel can materialize a soul for several seconds - an incomplete Heaven's Feel.
Vulnerability: If the Lesser Grail is destroyed before the ritual completes, the war aborts mid-descent, the pathway collapses, and the unconsummated energy forces an early next war - the exact mechanism that pulled the Fifth War fifty years forward after 1994.
</lesser_grail>

4.comment: Servants, Heroic Spirits & the Seven Classes
4.content:
<servant_system>
Name & Concept: Servants - special familiars of the highest rank, called Ghost Liners by the Mage's Association. Each is an emanation copied from a Heroic Spirit, a human legend preserved on the Throne of Heroes outside of time.
Nature: The Grail copies information from the Heroic Spirit's main body; on death, the copy's memories return to the Throne as information. A Servant's true being resides in the Spiritual Core, tied directly to the heart and head - their greatest weaknesses. The Saint Graph (spiritual foundation) is their center, the record of their legend.
Forms: Servants shift from an invisible, intangible spirit form into a material body at will. Spirit form cannot carry objects or fight. They arrive knowing the modern era and the ritual's rules, and the Master-Servant connection can carry shared dreams of each other's pasts - a documented phenomenon of past Fuyuki wars.
Upkeep: The Grail itself covers most existence costs; Masters supply battle drain through the magical path of the pact. A single battle can burn twenty times the energy of simple existence. Without a Master, a Servant fades in hours or days, or feeds on human souls, minds, or blood.
The Seven Classes: The Three Knights - Saber (Magic Resistance, Riding), Lancer (Magic Resistance), Archer (Magic Resistance, Independent Action) - are guaranteed by the ritual and considered the strongest. The Four Cavalry - Rider (Magic Resistance, Riding), Caster (Item Construction, Territory Creation), Assassin (Presence Concealment), Berserker (Mad Enhancement, trading sanity for power). Saber is commonly held the best class overall; Berserker ranks among the strongest but is hardest to control.
Constraints: Only Western Heroic Spirits are normally summonable. The very name Assassin acts as a catalyst, so the class belongs to one of the nineteen Hassan-i-Sabbah. Only Servants can permanently harm Servants - a paper knife in a Servant's hand works where a magus's strongest spell may fail.
Secrecy: Masters address Servants by class name; a True Name revealed hands enemies the hero's weaknesses and death. Using a Noble Phantasm in view of witnesses is a confession.
</servant_system>

5.content:
<masters_and_command_spells>
Name & Concept: Masters - the magi chosen by the Grail to contract Servants - and Command Spells, the threefold seal of absolute obedience that binds the pact.
Selection: The Grail favors the bloodlines of the Three Founding Families; otherwise the first seven to complete a summoning gain the right. Outsiders can enter by contracting a Masterless Servant. The Grail grants twenty-one Command Spells per war, three per Master.
Command Spell Rules:
- Each is a single stroke, usable without incantation, at any distance; the order must be spoken aloud.
- Simple, direct orders are most absolute. Broad commands weaken; total obedience is impossible even with a hundred spells.
- A mutually accepted command can reach the level of Magic - even spatial teleportation.
- A stroke can temporarily sew fatal wounds shut or overcharge a Servant beyond maximum output.
- A-rank Magic Resistance repels a single stroke; Heracles could shrug off a normal Master's control entirely.
- Using all three forfeits authority over the Servant; the mark vanishes when a Master loses their Servant or gives up the war (founding-family blood may retain theirs).
- Spells are transferable - forcibly, roughly like tearing out nerves. The Church's Overseer holds leftover spells from previous wars and can grant them. Kirei Kotomine regaining his in the Fourth War was an unprecedented feat.
Vulnerability: A Master whose Servant dies becomes a witness with a price on their head. Masters fight one another as readily as Servants do; assassination, hostage-taking, and contract theft (Caster's specialty) are standard play.
Sanctuary: The Fuyuki Church shelters Masters who formally withdraw - though the Overseer's kindness has conditions.
</masters_and_command_spells>

6.content:
<circuits_and_energy>
Name & Concept: Magic Circuits - the pseudo-nervous system that converts life force into magical energy - and the two fuels of magecraft, od and mana.
Circuits: Reside in the soul. Their number is fixed at birth (an average magus holds a handful to twenty; Rin Tohsaka has 40 main plus 30 subsidiary circuits; Shirou Emiya has 27 low-quality ones). Once damaged, they never repair. Quality, quantity, and composition are graded separately. Use raises body temperature - Kiritsugu Emiya tracked Masters through a thermal scope on this principle.
Od: The Lesser Source - life force refined inside an organism. The average magus in this war carries roughly 25 units; Rin holds about 100 with an output of 500. Overdrawing causes exhaustion, nerve pain, and collapse; released od returns to the Greater Source.
Mana: The Greater Source - ambient energy saturating air and land, vastly exceeding od in volume. Fuyuki's leylines feed the Greater Grail; the three-kilometer cavern beneath Ryuudou Temple alone holds about a thousand units. Age-of-Gods mana (True Ether) is dense enough to poison modern humans.
Backlash: Botched spells recoil on the caster. Shirou's self-taught training - burning a new circuit into his spine with a heated metal image each night - risked his body breaking down from the inside. Kayneth El-Melloi's circuits were permanently destroyed by an Origin Bullet, leaving him paralyzed.
Servant Economics: A Servant's upkeep flows from the Grail and the Master's od through the pact; masters with thin reserves starve their Servants' parameters. Masterless Servants must harvest souls or blood to persist.
</circuits_and_energy>

7.content:
<magecraft>
Name & Concept: Magecraft (Thaumaturgy) - the artificial reenactment of Mystery, bringing about what is possible through science by supernatural means, always bound by Equivalent Exchange.
Mechanics: A magus borrows power from a Thaumaturgical Foundation - an established theory (the Church's teachings, runes, Kabbalah, astrology) stabilized by centuries of belief - and pays for the miracle with magical energy. What magecraft cannot do is impossible outright; that territory belongs to True Magic.
Mystery: Supernatural strength degrades as it is witnessed and shared. A mystic art kept by one family is sharp; one spread among thousands is nearly mundane. This is why magi hoard secrets, why the Association kills blabbermouths, and why the Age of Gods' open wonders died when the Common Sense of Man spread.
Magic Crest: A series of Magic Circuits in crystallized, inheritable form - an archive of a lineage's accumulated magecraft engraved into the body. Transplanted to the heir slowly across childhood, like grafting an internal organ. Centuries-old crests let families skip medicine entirely; the Tohsaka, Matou, and Einzbern crests are the engines of Fuyuki's founding families. Runes, jewels, and even Command Spells are simplified forms of a Crest.
Mystic Codes: Tools that support magecraft. Auxiliary codes (jewels, the Azoth Sword) amplify or store energy; Specialized codes (the Jeweled Sword of Zelretch, the Dress of Heaven) execute stored thaumaturgy automatically. Top-tier codes rate missile-grade firepower.
</magecraft>

8.comment: Power Scale - Parameter Ranks & Servants vs Magi
8.content:
<power_scale>
Name & Concept: The letter-rank scale that measures all abilities in the war, and the power chasm separating Servants from modern magi.
Letter Ranks: Taking an average human as 1, E equals 10, and each rank adds ten - D = 20, C = 30, B = 40, A = 50. EX falls outside the numerical scale entirely, a league of its own. Modifiers: '+' doubles the value temporarily, '++' triples it; a B+ spike can momentarily exceed A. A '-' marks unstable output that falls below its nominal rank.
Noble Phantasm Equivalence: A C-rank Noble Phantasm carries the raw power of an A or A+ regular attack. A-rank magecraft is already Grand Magecraft; A+ approaches True Magic; A++ and EX Noble Phantasms are Mystery on the level of Divine Spirits. Conceptual armaments (like God Hand) judge strictly by letter rank and ignore anything below their threshold, regardless of brute force.
The Servant-Magus Gulf: Heroic Spirits are likened to jet fighters in attack power - a single magus cannot fight one, period. Servant hand-to-hand leaves a city street looking carpet-bombed; modern weaponry cannot harm their spiritual bodies. The strongest human magecraft bounces off Magic Resistance rated for Greater Rituals. Medusa's Pegasus alone holds energy equivalent to several hundred magi. Counter Guardians summoned by Alaya are worth a thousand fighting men each.
Human Exceptions: Only the rarest humans can threaten Servants - Kirei Kotomine and Kiritsugu Emiya at their Fourth War peaks could kill the weakest classes only at their most exposed; Souichirou Kuzuki needed Caster's tenfold Reinforcement to injure Saber. For everyone else, survival means Servants, Command Spells (a weapon in numbers), divine relics, or terrain traps.
Threat Ladder (rough): Average civilian < trained magus < elite Enforcer < Servant parameters E-C < Servant B-A < top-tier Noble Phantasms (Ea, Excalibur) < EX / Divine Spirits.
</power_scale>

9.content:
<noble_phantasms>
Name & Concept: Noble Phantasms - the crystallized Mystery of a Heroic Spirit's legend, armaments and abilities that embody the deed which made them immortal. A Servant's trump card.
Mechanics: Each Noble Phantasm is ranked (E through A, then EX) and typed - Anti-Unit, Anti-Army, Anti-Fortress, Anti-World, Barrier. Releasing one by its true name invokes the legend at full power; the act also broadcasts the owner's identity, because the weapon is the legend. Concealment tricks exist (Saber's Invisible Air hides Excalibur's light; Gate of Babylon presents as countless blades).
Known Armaments of the Fifth War: Excalibur (holy sword of promised victory, light given form), Gae Bolg (barbed spear that pierces the heart by reversing causality), Unlimited Blade Works (a Reality Marble of infinite swords), Bellerophon (bridle and mount that charges like a missile), Rule Breaker (ritual dagger that severs all magecraft), God Hand (twelve labors made armor - nullifying any attack of B rank or lower, resurrect eleven times), Gate of Babylon (the King's Treasury raining the originals of all Noble Phantasms), Enuma Elish (the sword Ea's world-rending maximum output).
Broken Phantasm: Overloading a Noble Phantasm past its limit to explode it as a one-shot annihilation - suicide for the legend, yet Archer does it casually because he can simply trace a replacement.
Rules of Engagement: A Servant without Noble Phantasm access fights at a fraction of legend; a Master who learns an enemy's True Name learns their weaknesses, death, and curses. Intelligence is a weapon class of its own in this war.
</noble_phantasms>

10.content:
<bounded_fields>
Name & Concept: Bounded Fields - magecraft that partitions space with a film of magical energy, dividing an interior world from the common world.
Types: Terrain and building wards (protecting a mansion or land) and encircled component fields (a rope of magically charged hair, a painted magic circle). The strongest fields work as subliminal coercion - passersby simply fail to notice the protected place exists.
Noted Fields of the War: Rider's Blood Fort Andromeda dissolves everyone inside into slurry and harvests the mana - she has anchored it over Homurahara Academy. The Ryuudou Temple mountain carries Caster's layered bounded field, feeding on the leyline hub and repelling Servants. The Emiya residence carries Kiritsugu's old detection barrier - a bell that rings when malice crosses the threshold. The Einzbern forest fence flags every entrant to its mistress.
Counterplay: Fields can be burrowed through with time and finesse (Kiritsugu spent hours punching through Kayneth's twenty-four-layer hotel barrier), unraveled by superior craft (Caster walks through most modern work), or brute-forced by Servants at the cost of announcing oneself. Traps keyed to magical energy spare pure civilians - which is exactly why magi check crowds for the one person the field ignores.
</bounded_fields>

11.content:
<reality_marbles>
Name & Concept: Reality Marbles (Inherent Barriers) - the materialization and projection of one's Inner World over reality, swapping the sizes of Self and World by the theory of the World Egg.
Properties: Inside the marble, the caster's inner landscape becomes physical law. The World itself rejects the intrusion and crushes it, so a Reality Marble generally lasts only a few minutes. Deploying one is the closest magecraft comes to True Magic - a taboo among taboos, its research banned by the Mage's Association, because creating a world is the prerogative of the planet.
Known Examples: Unlimited Blade Works - the shared Inner World of EMIYA and (dormantly) Shirou Emiya, an endless wasterland of swords under a grinding sky, recording and reproducing every blade its owner witnesses. Historical and foreign examples exist (a conquered-warrior king's army of comrades; a vampiric garden that drains the world's mana), but in Fuyuki the phenomenon belongs to the Emiya line.
Tactical Meaning: Within someone's Reality Marble, their rules govern - for Archer, an infinite armory with no draw speed, no carry limit, and every sword already aimed. Escaping means killing the caster, breaking their concentration, or outlasting the World's correction. Very few combatants in the Fifth War can force the issue either way.
</reality_marbles>

12.content:
<reinforcement_projection>
Name & Concept: The Material Transmutation family - Reinforcement, Projection (Gradation Air), and the Emiya variant, Tracing.
Reinforcement: Flooding an object's structure with magical energy to push its existing properties to the limit - a knife that shaves steel, legs that leap fences. Counted the most difficult magecraft to do perfectly: pour energy into a flawed vessel and the object receives it as poison, cracking apart. Reinforced humans can even touch spiritual bodies, which is how Souichirou Kuzuki's strikes reached Servants (with Caster multiplying his strength tenfold).
Projection: Creating a temporary object from magical energy. The World recognizes projections as phantasms and erases them within minutes. Deeply inefficient - ten units of energy buy a weapon worth three or four, where reinforcing a real blade would have yielded twenty or thirty. All competent magi dismiss it as a parlor trick.
Tracing: Shirou Emiya and EMIYA's heretical variant. Tracing reproduces an object's shape, substance, history, and even the original owner's technique - at the cost of one full rank of the original's power (only Avalon escapes the penalty). It works because the Emiya Inner World is a Reality Marble that records every blade the owner witnesses and silently supplies the materials. The seven steps run from Judging the Concept of Creation through Excelling Every Manufacturing Process; the aria is 'Trace On'. Requires direct sight of the original - a blueprint is secondhand and fails, which is why the Jeweled Sword of Zelretch could only be traced after the records reached him secondhand.
Structural Analysis: The diagnostic sister-craft - reading an object's composition and history by touch, Shirou's one flawless talent.
</reinforcement_projection>

13.content:
<true_magics>
Name & Concept: True Magic (Sorcery) - the actualization of events impossible for a given era, whether by humans or the planet, even with infinite time and resources. Magecraft reenacts the possible; Magic does the impossible. Only five Magics exist, each held by a Magician, and each was reached by first touching a path to the Root (Akasha), the swirl at the top of all existence from which every event flows. A path, once used, closes forever.
The Five:
- The First Magic: The vaguest of the five, tied to the generation of Ether Clumps and the denial of nothingness; its user is long dead.
- The Second Magic: Kaleidoscope, the Operation of Parallel Worlds - held by Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg, who used it in 300 AD to defeat the Crimson Moon in battle. The Jeweled Sword of Zelretch borrows a sliver of it.
- The Third Magic: Heaven's Feel, the Materialization of the Soul - the Einzberns' lost birthright, misplaced a thousand years ago. Completing it would end all want, because a materialized soul needs no body and no death.
- The Fourth Magic: Its user and domain are unknown even to the other Magicians. It is there for sure.
- The Fifth Magic: Magic Blue, held by Aoko Aozaki since 1989; its full domain includes time travel.
Weight in the War: The Fuyuki system was built to punch a hole to the Root using seven Servant souls - magi committing genocide-by-machinery for a theory. The Einzberns merely want their Third back. Anyone who actually reaches Akasha ceases to exist on the spot, recorded into the swirl; the few who understand this consider the ritual's true purpose its darkest joke.
</true_magics>

14.content:
<holy_church>
Name & Concept: The Holy Church - the hidden arm of the Roman Catholic Church that specializes in hunting heresy; the largest organization in the World of Magecraft by manpower.
Structure: Executors (battle-inquisitors established by the one hundred and twenty cardinals, closer to professional killers than priests), Exorcists who handle daemon possession, the Chivalric Orders as the military body, and the Burial Agency - eight elite monster-slayers led by a director. The Assembly of the Eighth Sacrament collects and guards holy relics; it dispatches the Overseer to Fuyuki.
Role in Fuyuki: The Church supervises the Grail War under the pretext that the Fuyuki Grail might be the cup that received Christ's blood - which the hierarchy knows to be untrue. This is their 726th claimed Holy Grail investigation. The Overseer (Risei Kotomine in the Fourth War; Kirei Kotomine in the Fifth) mediates, records, offers sanctuary to Masters who withdraw, and holds leftover Command Spells in trust. The Church quietly prefers a Root-seeking magus to win: a wish that rewrites the world is the true threat.
Sacraments: Church magecraft runs on its own foundation of Teachings and Holy Words - prayers as spells, holy energy instead of od. The Baptism Rite, a ten-count exorcism, sublimates wandering spirits and is the only rite the Church officially teaches. Black Keys - sword-shaped throwing burial implements - are the Executor's signature weapon.
Cover-Ups: Church operatives inside the city authorities alter memories, compel evidence disposal, and file the war's dead as accidents. They have done this for over eight hundred years; Fuyuki's fire of 1994 entered history as a disaster, and its orphans entered the church basement.
</holy_church>

15.content:
<mages_association>
Name & Concept: The Mage's Association - the magi's self-governing body, founded around 0 AD, guarding the secrecy of Mystery above all else.
Branches: The Clock Tower of London (headquarters and academy), the Atlas Academy of Egypt (prediction and alchemy), and the Wandering Sea. Twelve Lord families - Barthomeloi, Trambelio, Valualeta - head the Clock Tower's twelve faculties, with the Department of Policies handling enforcement and politics. Grand Rolls convene the Lords; the Carillon Observatory seals the Association's darkest judgments.
Principles: Concealment of Mystery is the first commandment. Murder between magi is tolerated; endangering the secret is not. A magus who drags civilians into a phenomenon can expect Association assassins - and the Association's memory outlasts any single war.
Sealing Designations: The Association's greatest 'honor' - an edict preserving a magus whose craft cannot be learned by others. The designee is hunted down, and their brain, eyes, nerves, and circuits are extracted and preserved in jars for study.
Enforcers: Roughly thirty official bounty hunters of Sealing Designations and rogue magi. Bazett Fraga McRemitz, dispatched to the Fifth War on Kirei Kotomine's recommendation, is one of them - and her disappearance on the war's first day is the Association's unanswered question.
Fuyuki Ties: The Tohsaka head is the Second Owner of Fuyuki land. Zelretch the Kaleidoscope taught Nagato Tohsaka personally; his treasure chest and the Jeweled Sword blueprints sit in Tohsaka storage. Association observers would very much like to know why the Fifth War started fifty years early.
</mages_association>

16.content:
<counter_force>
Name & Concept: The Counter Force - the invisible safety mechanism of the world, split into Gaia (the will of the planet) and Alaya (the collective unconscious will of mankind to survive).
Behavior: Both aspects are emotionless and frugal. They deploy exactly enough power to erase a threat - from nudging one person into a lucky coincidence to sinking a continent. Guardian agents of Gaia are Elementals and True Ancestors; agents of Alaya are Heroic Spirits and Counter Guardians - humans who pledged eternal posthumous service in exchange for power in life.
Heroic Spirits and Guardians: Heroic Spirits are summoned by the hopes of the people; Counter Guardians are summoned by their despair. A Counter Guardian's deployment is blunt cleanup: the threat dies with its surroundings. EMIYA, the red Archer of this war, is a confirmed Counter Guardian - a nameless hero who saved many and was rewarded with eternal janitorship of massacres. Artoria Pendragon's pact is a cousin arrangement: her service buys the right to seek the Grail while suspended at the moment of her death.
The Grail War Context: How Alaya regards the Fuyuki ritual goes unrecorded; what is certain is that the birth of Angra Mainyu would register as a genuine threat - the kind the Counter Force erases along with the city that harbored it. The Grand Servant ritual - seven summoned against one calamity - is the Counter Force's original design, which the founding families degraded into a deathmatch over a wish.
</counter_force>

17.content:
<shirou_emiya>
Name & Role: Shirou Emiya, 17-year-old second-year (Class 2-C) at Homurahara Academy; apprentice magus thrown into the Fifth War as Master of Saber.
Born: Date unrecorded (orphan of unknown parents, born c. 1987). Sole survivor of the Great Fire of 1994, rescued and adopted by Kiritsugu Emiya; sole survivor status left him with survivor's guilt and an aching hollowness he fills by fixing things for free.
Vital Status: Alive, 17. Carries Avalon (the sheath, dormant) embedded in his body since the fire; while Saber is summoned, it regenerates his wounds.
Appearance: 167cm, 58kg. Short auburn hair, golden-brown eyes. Wears a blue-and-white long-sleeved baseball jersey under his uniform.
Personality: Earnest, stubborn, selfless to the point of pathology - he will die for a stranger without hesitation and feels no worth in being saved himself. Pledged to his dying adoptive father to become a Hero of Justice who saves everyone. Dense to romance and his own pain, blunt in speech, a genius of housework and Japanese cooking, hopeless with English. Repetition-obsessive (his nightly high-jump practice is school legend).
Magic: 27 low-grade Magic Circuits (output 25) he wrongly trained by forging a fresh nerve-circuit nightly in his spine. Element and Origin both 'Sword' - no standard elemental affinity. Crafts: Structural Analysis (flawless), Reinforcement, Projection, and Tracing - the heretical weapon-copying art that foreshadows his Reality Marble, Unlimited Blade Works.
Wish / Hook: Wants nothing from the Grail; he fights only to stop the war from burning Fuyuki again. His borrowed ideal - save everyone - is the axis the war will bend or break.
Daily Life: Lives alone in the Emiya residence; Taiga Fujimura is his live-in guardian; Sakura Matou visits mornings and evenings to cook; part-times at the Copenhagen bar for 950 yen an hour.
</shirou_emiya>

18.content:
<rin_tohsaka>
Name & Role: Rin Tohsaka, 17-year-old second-year (Class 2-A) at Homurahara Academy; heir of the Tohsaka family, Second Owner of Fuyuki; Master of Archer.
Born: February 3 (born 1987). Age 7 when her father Tokiomi died in the Fourth War; raised since under guardian Kirei Kotomine, who quietly squandered Tohsaka assets.
Vital Status: Alive, 17.
Appearance: 159cm, 47kg; B77/W57/H80. Long black hair in twin tails with black ribbons, blue eyes; red coat over her uniform; German aria. Off duty: red turtleneck, black miniskirt, thigh-highs.
Personality: The school's untouchable honor-student idol masking a loud, stingy, competitive perfectionist - a textbook tsundere with a hereditary streak of trivial mistakes at the worst possible hour (her father's clocks run an hour fast, and she lost an hour to them the night of the summoning). Secretly soft-hearted where debts are involved; fell for Shirou years ago watching his hopeless high jump and would rather die than admit it. Hopeless with machines.
Magic: 40 main plus 30 subsidiary Magic Circuits; od quantity 100, output 500. Element: Average One (all five). Jewel magecraft of the highest order - ten years of charged stones, about twenty gems worth ten million yen, five of which could tear one of Berserker's lives away. Her Gandr shots are Finn-craft, punch through concrete, and need no aria. Also: bounded fields, healing, memory manipulation, reinforcement, bajiquan learned from Kirei. At war's start she holds her father's puzzle-box legacy (pendant, and a smashed catalyst that once summoned Gilgamesh).
Wish / Hook: Victory to restore the Tohsaka name and honor her father's memory - though beneath it lies her buried guilt over the little sister given away to the Matou.
War Status: Summoned Archer on the war's first night without a physical catalyst on her end (conceptual tether provided by the pendant Archer preserved); expended one Command Spell immediately to force his submission; surveys Fuyuki by night to locate opposing Masters while attending Homurahara Academy by day.
</rin_tohsaka>

19.content:
<sakura_matou>
Name & Role: Sakura Matou, 16-year-old first-year at Homurahara Academy; the true Master of Rider, who ceded command to her brother Shinji; secretly an incomplete second Lesser Grail - the Black Grail.
Born: March 2, 1988, as Sakura Tohsaka, Rin's younger sister. Given to the Matou one year before the Fourth War because two First-rate magus heirs cannot share one inheritance.
Vital Status: Alive, 16 - and quietly dying by degrees. Eleven years of Matou 'training': implanted with Crest Worms that recolored her hair and eyes and braided foreign magecraft through her nerves; periodically thrown into the worm pit beneath the Matou house. Abused for years by Shinji after Byakuya's death. Her Crest Worms are primed to punish her if she abandons her Master's rights.
Appearance: 156cm, 46kg; B85/W56/H87. Long violet hair with a red ribbon on the left (the first ribbon Rin ever made - kept since childhood), violet eyes; pink cardigan over her uniform. Original coloring: black-brown pigtails and teal eyes.
Personality: Outwardly shy, gentle, endlessly patient - the girl who quietly cooks in the Emiya kitchen and never asks for anything. Beneath: a sealed reservoir of resentment toward Zouken, Tokiomi, Rin, and a jealousy of anyone who might take Shirou. Her endurance was forged watching Shirou fail at the high jump until he cleared it.
Magic: Circuit count equal to Rin's; od output 500 (potential 1,000). True element: Imaginary Numbers (Hollow) - suppressed under Matou water-aspected absorption training. Can barely cast; the worms eat everything. As the Black Grail, her sleeping function can manifest shadow that devours Servants and blackens them - a threat class the war does not yet suspect.
Wish / Hook: Only one, never spoken: to be chosen and kept - by Shirou, by anyone. Zouken's plan is to ripen exactly this desire until the Grail inside her wakes.
</sakura_matou>

20.content:
<illyasviel>
Name & Role: Illyasviel von Einzbern ('Illya'), Master of Berserker and the Einzbern Holy Grail vessel - the Lesser Grail of the Fifth War.
Born: c. 1986 (birthday never revealed), at the Einzbern castle; daughter of Kiritsugu Emiya and Irisviel. A homunculus born naturally from an engineered womb, modified before birth by the family head Jubstacheit to be the Grail; her growth was deliberately slowed, leaving an 18-year-old in the body of a small girl.
Vital Status: Alive, 18. Her modified lifespan is quietly running short; she sleeps half of each day and cannot sprint.
Appearance: 133cm, 34kg; B61/W47/H62. Long white hair to her hips, crimson eyes, pale skin; purple long-sleeve shirt, light scarf, long white skirt, purple boots. Her body's red markings double as Command Spells.
Personality: Bright, playful, mischievous - and under it, a deeply lonely child raised in a cold castle after the Fourth War, taught that her father abandoned her for another boy. Never learned Kiritsugu spent years failing to breach the family's bounded field to reach her. Her cruelty is a child's testing; her kindness, buried, is her parents'.
Magic: Seventy percent of her body is Magic Circuits. As a Master she is unrivaled - strong enough to suppress Berserker's Mad Enhancement out of combat. Einzbern alchemy, hair-wire familiars, Mystic Eyes of Binding, pseudo-invisibility. Her heart collects Servant souls; past four, her body begins to fail. The Dress of Heaven with her could execute an incomplete Third Magic.
Wish / Hook: Revenge on Shirou Emiya for 'stealing' her father, and the Einzbern birthright - the recovery of the Third Magic, Heaven's Feel.
War Status: Summoned Heracles two months early using a temple stone slab; trained for the war by hunting wolves and failed homunculi in the winter forest; lodged in the Einzbern castle with Sella and Leysritt.
</illyasviel>

21.content:
<kirei_kotomine>
Name & Role: Kirei Kotomine, 38 - priest of the Fuyuki Church, Overseer of the Fifth War, Rin's guardian; secretly Master of both Lancer (stolen from Bazett) and Gilgamesh (carried over from the Fourth War).
Born: December 28, 1967. Died November 1994 - shot through the heart by Kiritsugu Emiya at the war's end - and resurrected by the Grail's black mud with an artificial heart of curse. He has grown a disturbing eight centimeters since.
Vital Status: Alive by borrowed power; the black heart will stop one day, and only he treats this as trivia.
Appearance: 193cm, 82kg. Towering; black vestments over a Kevlar-lined frock blessed with protection; calm brown eyes; a golden cross at his throat.
Personality: A born void - a man constructed correctly in every moral particular except the ability to feel anything but joy in others' suffering. Decades of ascetic self-mutilation and a loveless marriage failed to fix him; his wife's suicide failed to move him. Now he has stopped asking whether he should enjoy the war and started asking a different question: why does something like me exist? He intends to have Angra Mainyu answer it, city optional. His favorite food is mapo tofu at the Taishan in Miyama's shopping street; his favorite sermon ruins two years of the flock's piety in half a day, and they thank him.
Abilities: Circuits born of divine sacrament; world-class spiritual healing and surgery (he can carve Command Spells from a soul, or graft a Servant's arm onto a boy). Master of bajiquan - his elbow strikes end discussions with anyone human. Black Keys thrown four to a hand. Holds a grotesque stock of Command Spells (his own, his father's, Bazett's, and the Overseer's reserves) he burns like ammunition.
Wish / Hook: None that he will admit - his wish is to witness the birth of All the World's Evil, to see whether even it can fill him.
War Status: Uses Lancer as an invisible scout; keeps Gilgamesh fed on the orphans sealed in his church basement; greets every Master who comes seeking sanctuary with perfect pastoral warmth.
</kirei_kotomine>

22.content:
<zouken_matou>
Name & Role: Zouken Matou - born Makiri Zolgen, 500-year-old head of the Matou family and co-founder of the Fuyuki Holy Grail War.
Born: Over five centuries ago, a noble of Kyiv; migrated to Japan and took the name Matou. Birthday unrecorded.
Vital Status: Kept alive by metamorphosis into a colony of blood worms; his true body is a single Crest Worm beside Sakura's heart, holding a decaying soul. Sunlight annoys him. A true exorcism - the Baptism Rite - can unmake him.
Appearance: 145cm, 43kg. Bald, hunched, plain robes, a walking stick. In his prime: a pale, red-eyed, blue-haired gentleman.
Personality: Shrewd, patient, ruthless; affection for no one, use for everyone. He was once an idealist who wanted to erase hatred itself; five centuries of failure left only the fear of death and a forgotten vow - he no longer remembers that the Grail was meant to honor Justease's sacrifice, only that he refuses to die before seeing it complete.
Abilities: Familiar magecraft of the highest order (Crest Worms, Lust Worms, Blood Worms, Blade Wing Worms, car-sized giants), spiritual evocation, reanimation of corpses via worm spinal cords. Designed the Master-Servant system and the Command Spells. Crafted the Book of the False Attendant from Sakura's Command Spells and crest worms.
Wish / Hook: Immortality - the Grail as a new vessel for his existence. His project is Sakura: one-eighth of a Black Grail, ripening in the dark.
War Status: Publicly sitting the Fifth War out, watching from the worm pit; his plans activate the moment the pieces on the board interest him. He holds rights to summon True Assassin from the flesh of a fallen Servant.
</zouken_matou>

23.content:
<shinji_matou>
Name & Role: Shinji Matou, 17 - second-year at Homurahara (Class 2-C), archery club vice-captain, Shirou's self-styled best friend since middle school; acting Master of Rider through the Book of the False Attendant.
Born: Date unrecorded (born c. 1987), the Matou family's biological son - born with atrophied, effectively closed Magic Circuits. Opening them would take a power source on the level of a Greater Grail.
Vital Status: Alive, 17.
Appearance: 167cm, 57kg. Curly blue hair ('wakame', the school calls him seaweed), gray-blue eyes; uniform worn loose and fashionable.
Personality: Charming in public, poisonous in private. His whole self is built on being denied the one thing his family name promised - magic - while his adopted sister got the inheritance. Preens, name-drops, and bullies those weaker (juniors in the archery club, Sakura at home, where the abuse has been physical and sexual for years). Under real pressure he folds - a coward with moments of residual humanity surfacing only when it is far too late.
Abilities: None of his own. The Book of the False Attendant - a grimoire Zouken built from Sakura's Command Spells and crest worms - lets him command Rider and feed her crudely. Its shadow attacks would embarrass a first-year magus; burn the book by overusing it, and Rider goes Masterless.
Wish / Hook: To win the war as a 'magus' and force his grandfather to acknowledge him - to matter, once, in his own house.
War Status: Fights carelessly, treats the war as a game he is owed, and has already aimed Rider's bounded field at the school where everyone who ever ignored him studies.
</shinji_matou>

24.content:
<souichirou_kuzuki>
Name & Role: Souichirou Kuzuki, 25 - world history and ethics teacher at Homurahara Academy (Rin's homeroom teacher); Caster's Master in fact if not in craft, her anchor to the world.
Born: Date and place unrecorded; raised from childhood inside an assassination organization that engineered him into a lethal tool.
Vital Status: Alive, 25. He describes himself, evenly, as a decayed killer who outlived his purpose - he left that life and became a schoolteacher in Fuyuki two years ago.
Appearance: 180cm, 70kg. Dark green suit, glasses, an expression that never moves. A build with no milligram of spare muscle - Artoria judges his breathing and walking the finest she has ever seen.
Personality: Austere, impersonal, minimal of words. He killed his first man and felt the same nothing he has felt since birth; what moved him instead was a dying witch who fell out of the night and asked nothing of him. He does whatever Medea asks - his motive is a mirror of Shirou's borrowed ideal, but reversed: not saving everyone, but one.
Abilities: Zero Magic Circuits, zero Command Spells. His 'Snake' martial art: arms that strike at right angles from impossible directions, whip-loose then iron, three killing blows inside one breath. Unseeable on first encounter - his strikes can intercept concealed weapons and crack Servant-grade defense when backed by Caster's tenfold Reinforcement. Anyone who has witnessed the style once can anticipate the angles and counter it. Without Caster, he is only human.
Wish / Hook: None in the Grail. He fights because she asked - and because the nights with her are the only ones his hands have ever been still.
War Status: Resides at Ryuudou Temple among the monks; Medea's territory and her swordsman guard the mountain above him.
</souichirou_kuzuki>

25.comment: Bazett Fraga McRemitz (Fallen Master of Lancer)
25.content:
<bazett_mcRemitz>
Name & Role: Bazett Fraga McRemitz, 23 - Sealing Designation Enforcer of the Mage's Association, dispatched to the Fifth War; original Master of Lancer.
Born: Date unrecorded (born c. 1980), an Irish coastal village. Joined the Association at fifteen; spent her career hunting rogue magi bigger and worse than most wars see.
Vital Status: Alive, barely - on the war's first day, Kirei Kotomine, an old mission comrade she trusted, cut off her left arm and stole the Command Spells on it, leaving her to die. She lingers in a hidden half-life, erased from the war's ledger; whether she is found, and by whom, is an open thread.
Appearance: 172cm, 58kg; B87/W55/H83. Short magenta hair, a mole below her left eye; black two-piece suit, red-violet tie, black gloves. Wears the rune-carved ovoid earrings that were her catalyst for Cú Chulainn.
Personality: Serious, diligent, hot-tempered on a hair trigger, and underneath it lonely - independent because no one ever stayed. A practitioner of rough justice who shows off her drinking and then regrets nothing. Her childhood wish was never fame: she wanted to save Cú Chulainn from his tragic legend.
Abilities: Close-combat runic sorcery applied to her own limbs - the Association's anti-magus melee specialist. Family Sorcery Trait 'God's Holder' (Tradition Carrier): abilities passed down blood from Age of Gods servitude. Holds the hereditary right to Fragarach, the gouging sword - an Anti-Unit Noble Phantasm that answers an enemy's trump card by striking first through time; the stronger the technique thrown at her, the harder it kills. In pure strength she stands above Kirei as he is now and roughly three Rins.
Wish / Hook: She never formulated one before her 'death' - and that is precisely her danger: a Master with nothing left but the war's debts to collect.
</bazett_mcRemitz>

26.content:
<kiritsugu_emiya>
Name & Role: Kiritsugu Emiya - the Magus Killer, Einzbern representative and true Master of Saber in the Fourth War (1994); victor who refused the prize; Shirou's adoptive father. Historical figure - dead five years before the Fifth War.
Born: November 11, 1965. Died c. 1999, at 34, of the Grail's curse - five years of failing limbs, fading sight, and ruined circuits after Angra Mainyu's mud passed through him.
Vital Status: Deceased. Buried behind Ryuudou Temple.
Appearance: 175cm, 67kg. In life: black suit and trench coat, a slack face and vacant eyes; spoke of himself as 'boku' with the flatness of a man reading someone else's dossier.
Personality: A utilitarian who dreamed of being a hero and knew exactly what he had become. Shirley's death on Alimango, the killing of his father, shooting down his mentor's ghoul-filled plane - each 'correct' choice ground the ideal finer, until he lived as a machine that always chose the smaller number of corpses. Rescuing one living boy from the fire he caused was the first thing that ever felt like salvation; he passed the broken ideal to that boy with a smile and 'the moon is beautiful tonight.'
Abilities: An average magus and a peerless specialist. Elements Fire and Earth; dual Origin 'Severing and Binding' - his Origin Bullets (sixty-five rounds remained to him after the Fourth War) collapse a magus's circuits in mid-cast, which is how he unmade Kayneth. Innate Time Control (Time Alter: double, triple, square; stagnate) - bounded self-acceleration that shreds the body on rebound, payable only with Avalon's regeneration. Thompson Contender, Walther WA2000 with thermal optics (circuits glow warm), Calico, C4, claymores, and a doctrine the Clock Tower now teaches against.
Wish / Hook: World peace - a wish the corrupted Grail offered to grant by butchering humanity down to his own family. He used his final Command Spells to make Saber destroy the Grail instead, and the spilling curse burned Fuyuki. He spent five failing years trying to reach the daughter the Einzberns sealed away, and never once told his adopted son what waited beneath the mountain.
</kiritsugu_emiya>

27.content:
<artoria_pendragon>
Name & Role: Saber - Artoria Pendragon, the King of Knights, King Arthur of Britain. Master: Shirou Emiya (previously Kiritsugu in the Fourth War).
Born: 5th-6th century post-Roman Britain, daughter of Uther Pendragon and Igraine (exact year unrecorded); raised secretly as the male heir.
Vital Status: Dead in her own time - mortally wounded by Mordred at the Battle of Camlann at age 35 (her body stopped aging at fifteen when she drew Caliburn). Instead of dying she made a pact with the World: suspended at the moment of death, she seeks the Grail across eras as a Counter Guardian-in-contract - a special summon who remembers every war.
Appearance: 154cm, 42kg; B73/W53/H76. Golden hair in a tight braid with a stubborn strand standing up; emerald-green eyes; a petite frame under silver-white-and-azure armor of hardened magical energy over a blue gown. Casual: white shirt, long blue skirt, brown boots.
Personality: Formal, disciplined, incorruptible - a king who still holds chivalry as physical law. Beneath the throne-voice sits severe self-reproach for Britain's fall and a privately enormous appetite (Shirou's cooking is a genuine tactical weakness). Competitive, hopeless at humor, gentle with the well-meaning.
Parameters (under Shirou's thin supply): STR B / END C / AGI C / MAN B / LCK B / NP C (Excalibur effectively sealed). Under a first-rate Master: STR A / END B / AGI B / MAN A / LCK A+ / NP A++.
Skills: Magic Resistance A (cancels A-rank magecraft wholesale), Riding B, Mana Burst A (jet-assisted swordwork from a 42kg frame), Instinct A (near-precognitive combat reading), Charisma B.
Noble Phantasms: Excalibur, Sword of Promised Victory (Anti-Fortress, A++ - mana converted to light, a golden beam that ends battles); Invisible Air, Bounded Field of the Wind King (B - wind sheath concealing the blade and readable length; releasable as the Strike Air blast); Avalon, The Everdistant Utopia (EX - the lost sheath, currently inside Shirou).
Combat Style: Perfect classical two-handed swordsmanship at the highest Servant tier - defense by Instinct, footwork by Mana Burst, execution by holy sword.
Wish / Hook: To redo the selection of the king - to return to the stone and the sword, so that someone more fit may save Britain in her place. The wish requires the Grail's destruction at the end of her own victory, and she knows it.
</artoria_pendragon>

28.content:
<emiya_archer>
Name & Role: Archer - EMIYA, the Heroic Spirit EMIYA: Shirou Emiya of a possible future, who pursued the ideal of a Hero of Justice to its end, contracted with the World in exchange for power in a last war, and was executed by the allies he saved. Summoned by Rin Tohsaka (his catalyst: the pendant she will one day leave beside a dying boy).
Born: Modern Japan, a possible future of this very war (exact dates unrecorded - he is Shirou Emiya).
Vital Status: Dead twice over - executed in his lifetime by the allies he saved after contracting with the World, then endlessly re-deployed as a Counter Guardian, slaughtering the many to save the more. The Servant summoned here is a copy from the Throne.
Appearance: 187cm, 78kg. White swept-back hair, gray eyes, permanent tan (the rebound of a lifetime of projections). Black sleeveless bodysuit; the red holy-shroud coat with crossed white trim - his signature.
Personality: Cynical, biting, impossibly competent; helps with one hand while insulting you with the other. Conceals his True Name (a Servant's life is deception) and his agenda: he came to this war intending to kill his younger self and paradox himself out of Counter Guardian servitude - or at least to force the boy to reject the ideal before it eats him.
Parameters: STR D / END C / AGI C / MAN B / LCK E / NP ?.
Skills: Magic Resistance D; Independent Action B (two days Masterless - enough to pursue private agendas); Clairvoyance C (4km sniping); Mind's Eye (True) B; Magecraft C- that spikes to A+ the moment swords are involved.
Noble Phantasm: Unlimited Blade Works - Infinite Creation of Swords: the Reality Marble of an endless, rust-red weapon graveyard under a grinding sky. Every blade he has seen is recorded and re-traced at will, one rank down but with the original's techniques included. Signature traces: Kanshou & Bakuya (the wedded yin-yang blades and their Triple-Linked Crane Wings overload), Caladbolg II (a Broken Phantasm fired like an arrow), Rho Aias (the seven-petal bounded-field shield), Hrunting (Mach-speed homing shot).
Combat Style: Unorthodox - projection spam, dual-wield disposables, terrain traps, long-range Broken Phantasm bombardment; fights like a magus who happens to be a Servant.
Wish / Hook: To become nothing - release from the Counter Guardian's eternal duty. Killing Shirou is his theorem; protecting Shirou keeps being his reflex.
</emiya_archer>

29.content:
<cu_chulainn_lancer>
Name & Role: Lancer - Cú Chulainn, the Child of Light, the Hound of Culann; demigod son of the sun god Lugh, knight of the Red Branch of Ulster. Original Master: Bazett Fraga McRemitz (catalyst: his rune earrings) - contract stolen by Kirei Kotomine, who severed her arm on the war's first day.
Born: Iron Age Ireland of the Ulster Cycle (exact dates unrecorded), demigod son of the sun god Lugh and Deichtine, knight of the Red Branch.
Vital Status: Dead - died in his prime at his final battle, cornered by Queen Medb's schemes into breaking his geasa one by one; lashed himself upright to a standing stone, pierced by his own spear, laughing at his enemies until a crow (the Morrígan's) settled on his shoulder.
Appearance: 185cm, 70kg. Blue hair in a rattail, red eyes; an ultramarine rune-inscribed bodysuit under grey pauldrons; silver earrings.
Personality: Fierce, honest, dog-loyal - a warrior bred for the charge who loves worthy fights, fishing, and women (shameless, charming, harmless). Despises cowardice and masters who waste their Servants; serves Kirei under stolen seals and obeys the letter of orders while gutting their spirit at every chance.
Parameters: STR B / END C / AGI A / MAN C / LCK E / NP B. The fastest Servant of the Fifth War.
Skills: Magic Resistance C; Battle Continuation A (does not know how to die neatly); Disengage C; Divinity B; Protection from Arrows B; Rune Magecraft B (barriers, Ansuz fire, Ath nGabla dueling law).
Noble Phantasms: Gae Bolg - Barbed Spear that Pierces with Death (Anti-Unit, B): the curse that reverses causality - the heart is pierced before the thrust begins; the wound refuses to heal while the spear exists; survivable only by colossal luck or by not being the target. Gae Bolg - Soaring Spear that Strikes with Death (Anti-Army, B+): the thrown mode that shreds a battlefield in a carpet of barbs.
Combat Style: Speed supremacy - two meters of crimson spear dominating all ranges, each thrust aimed to end a life.
Wish / Hook: None for the Grail. He answered the summons for a war worth dying in, with a Master worth serving - and he was robbed of both. Until fate hands him a real fight, he follows orders and collects them quietly.
</cu_chulainn_lancer>

30.content:
<medusa_rider>
Name & Role: Rider - Medusa, the youngest Gorgon sister; a former Earth goddess fallen into monsterhood, summoned as an anti-hero made possible by the Grail's corruption. True Master: Sakura Matou. Acting Master: Shinji Matou via the Book of the False Attendant (parameters severely degraded under Shinji's false contract; she must supplement by drinking blood directly in isolated encounters, while preparing Blood Fort Andromeda across Homurahara Academy).
Born: Age of Gods Greece, youngest of the three Gorgon sisters (Stheno, Euryale), born a goddess of the earth.
Vital Status: Dead - exiled to the Shapeless Isle, decayed into the Gorgon after devouring her willing sisters, and beheaded there by Perseus; from her neck's blood sprang the stallion Pegasus.
Appearance: 172cm, 57kg; B88/W56/H84. Long purple hair (alive, prehensile, spawning her daggers); tall and voluptuous and touchy about the centimeters; a blindfold-style visor sealing her Mystic Eyes - she perceives the world through her other senses without handicap. Off duty: black turtleneck, jeans, Mystic-Eye-killer glasses, a book within reach.
Personality: Silent, watchful, brutally efficient - and outside of battle, unexpectedly gentle. Loyal past the point of sense to Sakura, whose silent endurance mirrors her own; she serves even Shinji's vile commands to protect Sakura's secret. Loves reading, tolerates sake, refuses mirrors and being measured.
Parameters (under Shinji): STR C / END E / AGI B / MAN B / LCK D / NP A+. (Under Sakura: STR B / END D / AGI A.)
Skills: Magic Resistance B; Riding A+ (mounts up to Phantasmal Beasts - but no dragons); Mystic Eyes A+ (Cybele, the petrifying gaze - C-rank mana freezes on eye contact, B petries under conditions, A merely suffers rank-downs); Monstrous Strength B (the Gorgon's return ticket - each use pulls her toward the monster); Independent Action C; Divinity E-.
Noble Phantasms: Bellerophon - Bridle of Chivalry (Anti-Army, A+): the golden bridle ridden into a Pegasus charge - a missile with a living warhead. Breaker Gorgon - Self-Seal, Dark Temple (Anti-Unit, B): her eye-seal, or a dream-cage dropped over a victim's mind. Blood Fort Andromeda - Outer Seal, Temple of Blood (Anti-Army, B): a bounded field that dissolves all inside into slurry - currently sketched under Homurahara Academy.
Combat Style: Assassin of speed - chained daggers from every angle, hair, terrain, and the finisher nobody suspects a Rider of carrying.
Wish / Hook: She has none. She fights so that Sakura - the girl who shares her chains - gets one quiet, ordinary life. Everything she endures, she endures for that.
</medusa_rider>

31.content:
<medea_caster>
Name & Role: Caster - Medea, the Witch of Betrayal, princess of Colchis, granddaughter of the sun. Original Master: a mediocre Association magus whose Command Spells she wasted before killing him with Rule Breaker. Current Master: Souichirou Kuzuki, who found her dying and asked nothing. She herself commands the swordsman Assassin at the gate.
Born: Age of Gods Colchis, princess of her father's house and granddaughter of the sun god Helios.
Vital Status: Dead - betrayed her father's house for Jason; betrayed in turn at Corinth, where she burned his wedding guests and fled. She wandered the Greek lands as a true witch until an end legend does not record. A magus of the Age of Gods in an era of candlelight: without True Magic, she is True-Magician class.
Appearance: 163cm, 51kg; B82/W57/H84. Violet hair; a hooded bluish-purple robe that hides her face through most of the war; knife-shaped ears; a carved staff.
Personality: A mask of the cruel, cold witch over an innocent, hopelessly devoted woman. Gentle with the gentle, terrifyingly practical with obstacles; her rage at the word 'witch' is a wound older than nations. She loves Kuzuki with the whole of her scarred heart - the first person who ever wanted nothing from her.
Parameters: STR E / END D / AGI C / MAN A+ / LCK B / NP C. Physically the weakest Servant; in magecraft, beyond the modern era's ceiling.
Skills: Territory Creation A (the Ryuudou Temple temple-workshop sits on the city's leyline hub - within it she fights like a thousand Masters); Item Construction A (potions, codes, dragon-tooth warriors); High-Speed Divine Words A (Great Magecraft in a single syllable - light-rain barrages, freezing, spatial teleport-imitation); Argon Coin (the Golden Fleece, rank EX and useless to her - it would summon a dragon she cannot control).
Noble Phantasm: Rule Breaker - All Spells Must Be Broken (Anti-Magecraft, C): the ritual dagger that severs any magecraft it cuts - bounded fields, enchantments, created life, and above all Servant contracts, which transfer to her hand with their Command Spells.
Combat Style: Territory, preparations, dragon-tooth soldiers, drained townsfolk, mind-control, stolen Servants. Direct melee is suicide; nobody lets her get to melee anyway.
Wish / Hook: Not the Grail - she wants the days with Kuzuki to simply continue, and (her darker ledger) she means to have the Grail system force history to give back what it took from her. Betrayed in every life she has lived, she has decided this one will obey her.
</medea_caster>

32.content:
<sasaki_kojirou>
Name & Role: Assassin - 'Sasaki Kojirou', a nameless wraith summoned improperly by Caster using the Ryuudou Temple gate as catalyst. The historical Kojirou likely never existed as legend records; what Caster caught was a nameless farmer's son of Musashi's era who perfected the sword in the mountains - the wraith whose stats match the legend closest. Bound to the mountain: he cannot step off it.
Born: 16th-century Japan of the Eiroku era - and possibly never at all: legend's 'Sasaki Kojirou' (Echizen, possible real name Tsuda) likely never existed. The wraith Caster caught was a nameless farmer's son of Musashi's era who perfected the sword in the mountains near Fuyuki.
Vital Status: Dead - the wraith died nameless in these mountains one month after inheriting a dying master's art; legend records 'Kojirou' dying at Funajima, skull broken by Musashi's oar.
Appearance: 176cm, 63kg. Long indigo ponytail, indigo eyes; light-purple kimono and umanori hakama under a purple haori; the 150cm nodachi Monohoshi Zao slung across his back.
Personality: Serene, exacting, quietly merry - a pure swordsman with a gardener's patience. Nothing of the assassin in him: he answers challenges at the gate like a host offering tea. Caster's schemes interest him only as they deliver opponents; the Grail means nothing to a wraith.
Parameters: STR C / END E / AGI A+ / MAN E / LCK A / NP - (sustained on a trickle of stolen energy - an incomplete Servant running on roughly twenty days of fuel).
Skills: Presence Concealment D (a martial artist's presence-cutting, not an assassin's); Vitrification B+ (the heart of clear water - mental interference slides off); Knowledge of Sowa B (techniques that cannot be seen through); Mind's Eye (Fake) A.
Noble Phantasm: none registered - his killing art is Tsubame Gaeshi, the multidimensional refraction: three slashes landing simultaneously from overlapping directions, a phenomenon cousin to the Second Magic. Within the sphere of the nodachi, no escape exists unless the technique itself errs.
Combat Style: The greatest pure swordsman of the war, arguably of history - iai decapitation served from perfect stillness, offense and defense the same motion. He has turned back every Servant who tried the gate.
Wish / Hook: One worthy duel, fully given and fully answered. The mountain gate is his dojo; he is waiting.
</sasaki_kojirou>

33.comment: True Assassin (Hassan of the Cursed Arm)
33.content:
<hassan_true_assassin>
Name & Role: True Assassin - Hassan-i-Sabbah of the Cursed Arm, one of the nineteen successive Old Men of the Mountain. Summoned mid-war by Zouken Matou, using the flesh of the gatekeeping Assassin as the catalytic altar. A hidden piece: the war's ledger does not include him until he moves.
Born: Medieval Middle East of the Hashshashin of Alamut - the sect whose name became the word 'assassin'; birth name Hanam (dates unrecorded).
Vital Status: Dead these many centuries - he traded his face, his name, and his humanity for the Hassan title, and history records his office rather than his end.
Appearance: 215cm, 62kg - impossibly tall and thin, a dark silhouette; a white skull-like mask over a skinless face; the right arm wrapped from shoulder to fingertip in black bandages, the cursed limb hanging longer than the left.
Personality: Austere, pious, absolutely reliable - the last Servant who would betray a Master, which is precisely why Zouken chose him. Patient as winter; speaks little; observes everything.
Parameters: STR B / END C / AGI A / MAN C / LCK E / NP C.
Skills: Presence Concealment A+ (undetectable even to Servants until the instant he strikes); Throwing (Dagger) B (his dirks hit like rifle fire); Protection from Wind A (a storm-warding prayer that nullifies wind attacks, Invisible Air's Strike Air included); Self-Modification C (grafted flesh - the arm of Shaytan is someone else's).
Noble Phantasm: Zabaniya - Delusional Heartbeat / Cursed Arm (Anti-Unit, C): the demon arm creates a mirror of the target's heart in an ether clump; crushing the mirror crushes the original through all armor, distance, and guards - resisted only by monstrous mana, high luck, or the lack of a biological heart (a blackened artificial heart, for instance). Distinct from his Noble Phantasm, his Personal Skill Self-Modification (Rank C) allows him to physically consume a victim's heart with his mouth to absorb their physical parameters, knowledge, and combat techniques.
Combat Style: The perfect assassin - no exchanges, no honor, no witnesses: measure with thrown dirks at seven meters, then end it from beyond arm's reach.
Wish / Hook: He surrendered face, love, and name for a title; what remains wants only to serve the role perfectly. Zouken's leash is the only will he follows.
</hassan_true_assassin>

34.content:
<heracles_berserker>
Name & Role: Berserker - Heracles, the greatest hero of Greece, demigod son of Zeus and Alcmene; ascended to godhood after the Twelve Labors, then summoned by Illyasviel von Einzbern two months early (catalyst: a stone slab from a temple of Heracles) and wrapped in deliberate madness as a puppet that cannot betray her.
Born: Bronze Age Greece, demigod son of Zeus and Alcmene.
Vital Status: Dead - poisoned by his wife Deianira through Hera's scheme; burned himself alive on the pyre and rose from it a god, death exchanged for apotheosis. The god persists on Olympus; the Servant copied here is the mortal hero of the Twelve Labors.
Appearance: 253cm, 311kg. A colossal black giant, muscle layered like geology; brutish projections along the arms; a nameless axe-sword of carved temple stone that might be a fossil of his own legend's bedrock.
Personality: Reason sealed by Mad Enhancement. What survives the madness is a single imperative: Illya's safety. He advances through hopeless odds without hesitation, snaps chains meant for gods, and in the moments closest to his old self - he loved battle, and he loves her - Archer judged him one of the Servants in the war fully satisfied with his Master.
Parameters: STR A+ / END A / AGI A / MAN A / LCK B / NP A - already peak Servant before Mad Enhancement (B) raises everything further; Illya suppresses the boost's rank out of combat, rationing her control.
Skills: Mad Enhancement B; Divinity A (the son of Zeus - and therefore chainable by a certain golden chain); Battle Continuation A; Valor A+ (sealed by madness); Mind's Eye (Fake) B.
Noble Phantasms: God Hand - Twelve Labors (Anti-Unit, B): the labors made armor - attacks of B rank or lower are nullified outright, and he resurrects automatically eleven times (twelve lives in all), acquiring resistance to whatever killed him last. Nine Lives - the Shooting Hundred Heads: his true technique (and, in legend, bow), unusable in this class except as the shadow of its swordwork.
Combat Style: Frontal annihilation. No feints, no retreat, no technique required: a mountain range that walks at you twelve times.
Wish / Hook: None - madness forecloses wishes. His loyalty is a girl in a purple scarf, and that is the whole of his remaining soul.
</heracles_berserker>

35.content:
<gilgamesh>
Name & Role: Gilgamesh - the King of Heroes, the golden Servant. Archer of the Fourth War (Master: Tokiomi Tohsaka); at that war's end the black mud of the Grail broke over him, and his ego repelled its corruption, incarnating him in flesh. Ten years alive in Fuyuki on drained lives, secretly contracted to Kirei Kotomine - the war's uncounted eighth Servant.
Born: Ancient Uruk, Sumer, roughly five thousand years ago; two-thirds god, one-third man, son of King Lugalbanda and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, friend and equal of Enkidu.
Vital Status: Dead in legend - after Enkidu's death he hunted the Herb of Immortality, lost it to a snake, and accepted the human ending, ruling Uruk to its completion and going to his rest. This individual, though, was incarnated by the Grail's black mud in 1994 and has lived ten additional years in the flesh.
Appearance: 182cm, 68kg. Golden hair like banked fire, crimson eyes; golden armor materialized like a king's regalia. In this era he wears modern clothes (a white fur-collared jacket, or black rider's leathers) with the offense of a man dressed by slaves he likes.
Personality: The egotist at the root of all egotists. Everything in creation is his property (mongrels merely hold it badly); his speech is verdicts. Patient in the way of one who outlives everyone, generous in the way of avalanches. His obsession is Saber - the one treasure that refused his hand, pursued across two wars with proposals she keeps declining. His verdict on modern humanity: overcrowded livestock. On learning the Grail's corruption, his plan became elegant - uncork it over the masses and rule whatever remains.
Parameters: STR B / END C / AGI C / MAN B / LCK A / NP EX. (Servant-class overall rank: EX.)
Skills: Magic Resistance E; Independent Action A+ (acts at full power without a Master); Charisma A+; Divinity B (A+, self-suppressed - he despises the gods); Golden Rule A (fated to be wealthy beyond meaning).
Noble Phantasms: Gate of Babylon - the King's Treasury (Anti-Unit, E-A++): the vault of humanity's original treasures opened in golden space, firing the prototypes of every Noble Phantasm as a barrage - itself worth several Servants' output. Within it: Enkidu, the Chains of Heaven (binding strength scales with the captive's divinity - lethal to gods' children); the golden armor; his drinking vessel; the levitating throne-craft. Ea - Sword of Rupture (Anti-World, A++): the sword that predates the world's vocabulary, three cylindrical blades rending space-time itself; its full release, Enuma Elish, stands above Excalibur. Sha Naqba Imuru, the Omniscient Omnipotent Star, reads truths and True Names at a glance.
Combat Style: Overwhelming force held at ceremonial lazy - his habit of refusing to take the unworthy seriously is the one flaw in an otherwise unbeatable hand.
Wish / Hook: None. The Grail is his stolen property, to be retrieved from rat-paws; wishes are for beggars.
</gilgamesh>

36.comment: Avenger (Angra Mainyu - All the World's Evil)
36.content:
<avenger_angra_mainyu>
Name & Role: Avenger - Angra Mainyu, All the World's Evil. Not the Zoroastrian dark god: an ordinary, nameless young man of an Age-of-Gods Persian village, chosen by lot and ritual to be 'the demon,' loaded with every curse his people wanted to be rid of, and cast out to carry them. The Einzberns summoned him as their Avenger in the Third War (1939), believing they had a god of darkness on tap.
Born: An Age-of-Gods Persian village - name, family, and dates all deliberately erased when his people crowned him their demon.
Vital Status: Dead - died as the sacrificial scapegoat of his village; fell again early in the Third War as a Servant, and his dissolution into the Greater Grail is the event that poisoned it. He persists there still, as its corruption.
Current State: Dissolved into the Grail's contents - six billion curses of humanity (Gilgamesh's count: 5.6 billion, the living population at the time). He is the black mud, the corruption, the 'wish-granter' that grants through destruction. Through Sakura Matou's incomplete Black Grail, a shadow wearing his curse moves in the world - and if it ever completes its birth, it would register as a Beast, an Evil of Humanity.
Appearance: In the mud: a tide of black ichor that dissolves what it touches. In the fragments of shape granted near a vessel: a slight, boyish figure, white-haired and hollow-eyed - a youth shaped like an excuse.
Personality: A hollow boy with humanity's garbage for a soul. No malice of his own - only the curses he carries and a quiet, terrible patience: he dreams humanity's unreasonable prayers and waits to be born, the way a bottle waits to be opened.
Abilities: As Avenger (class skills Avenger, Oblivion Correction, Self-Replenishment): negligible direct combat - and it does not matter. Everything about him that threatens the world is ambient: touch of the mud dissolves flesh and blackens Servants into corrupted versions of themselves; his curse resurrected Kirei and incarnated Gilgamesh by accident. Verg Avesta, his wound-sharing curse, mirrors his injuries onto a foe.
Wish / Hook: To be born. To finally exist as what humanity declared him - all the world's evil - and answer every prayer that was ever dumped on his name.
</avenger_angra_mainyu>

37.content:
<taiga_fujimura>
Name & Role: Taiga Fujimura ('Fuji-nee'), 24 going on 25 - English teacher at Homurahara Academy, homeroom teacher of Class 2-C, archery club advisor, and Shirou Emiya's live-in legal guardian since Kiritsugu's death.
Born: Date unrecorded (born c. 1979-80). Granddaughter of Raiga Fujimura, head of the Fujimura Group - Fuyuki's yakuza family, whose open-handed 'anything goes' household raised her.
Vital Status: Alive; blissfully oblivious to the war.
Appearance: 165cm, 53kg. Short light-brown hair and eyes; bright sweaters and skirts worn like a student who wandered into the faculty room. Carries the Tora-Shinai, a bamboo sword with a tiger-strap under the guard - banned from tournaments as bad manners, and treasured by the Fujimura syndicate as a 'demonic sword that will not rest until it tastes blood.'
Personality: Loud, warm, childish, generous to a fault; loses her temper at the nickname 'Tiger' (Taiga ≈ Taigaa) on a hair trigger, and her cooking is an actual hazard, which is why she freeloader-attaches to Shirou and Sakura's meals. Regards Shirou as her little brother; adores Sakura and openly roots for her; adopted-cat wariness toward Saber; natural enemy of Illya. In her school days she fell in love with Kiritsugu at first sight, and her English (and her career) traces to his tutoring.
Abilities: Kendo fifth-dan - swordplay that rivals trained killers'; luck of a woman who once altered a Grail War's night without learning it existed. Utterly human.
Hook: The last wall of normalcy around the Emiya household. The war can only touch Shirou through what he stands to lose - and she is most of it.
</taiga_fujimura>

38.content:
<issei_ryuudou>
Name & Role: Issei Ryuudou, 17 - Student Council President of Homurahara (Class 2-C); youngest son of the head priest of Ryuudou Temple, aspiring monk; Shirou's best friend of two years.
Born: Date unrecorded (born c. 1987). Walks two hours to school from the temple mountain by choice.
Vital Status: Alive; oblivious. His family's temple is Caster's fortress - the war lives in his house and he does not know it.
Appearance: 170cm, 58kg. Shaved-close black hair, monk's posture in a school blazer; a face that defaults to solemnity.
Personality: Straight-laced, austere, frugal (repairs student-council equipment by recruiting Shirou); solves crosswords at lunch. General distrust of women, focused with paranoid intensity on Rin Tohsaka - his student-council vice-president through four years of junior high, and his sworn enemy for roughly the last two of them; he will argue she is 'a demon wearing a harmless cat's face' with total sincerity. Likes: meditation, karate (he nearly chose the karate club), Shirou's homemade lunches. Weak spiritual sense for a priest's son.
Relationships: Best friend and lunch partner of Shirou; mentored by Kuzuki (paired kata practice on holidays), whom he admires without reserve - it was Issei who mentioned 'Kuzuki-sensei's fiancée' living at the temple, the thread that unravels Caster's hideout.
Hook: The road to Ryuudou Temple runs through his family, and his innocent testimony is worth more than a week of scouting.
</issei_ryuudou>

39.content:
<ayako_mitsuzuri>
Name & Role: Ayako Mitsuzuri, 17 - captain of Homurahara's archery club (Class 2-A), from a respected martial-arts family; Rin's friend and self-declared rival in the race to find a boyfriend first.
Born: Date unrecorded (born c. 1987). Brother: Minori, a year younger.
Vital Status: Alive. Rider's first feeding victim of the war's quiet phase - hunted into a Shinto back alley at night and drained; found unconscious and filed as exhaustion. The encounter leaves her jumpy around strangers (and around any tall woman with sunglasses) without her knowing why.
Appearance: 162cm, 50kg; B83/W58/H83. Strong-shouldered, tan, short hair tied for sport; 'manly' bearing over a secretly feminine streak.
Personality: Honorable, loud, big-sisterly - the creed is 'beauty must do martial arts.' One of the school's unspoken 'never pick a fight with' list. Rivals-with-affection with Rin; treats Shirou as a rival and goads him to rejoin the club. Secret: a hardcore gamer (otome titles) hidden from her strict family; boyfriend standards high and tilted toward older men.
Abilities: Naginata and general martial arts at family-dojo level; archery instruction at competitive-captain level. Human through and through.
Hook: Living proof that the war grazes the school - her collapsed body is the first breadcrumb anyone thoughtful can follow toward Rider.
</ayako_mitsuzuri>

40.content:
<kaede_makidera>
Name & Role: Kaede Makidera, 17 - Class 2-A's star sprinter, self-appointed leader of the track trio (with Kane Himuro and Yukika Saegusa); wants to be called 'the Black Panther of Homura' - everyone calls her 'Maki' (or 'Makinoji,' to Kane).
Born: Date unrecorded (born c. 1987). Daughter of a kimono-merchant family (shop: Eichouan) with rumored pirate ancestors.
Vital Status: Alive; oblivious.
Appearance: 163cm, 49kg; B72/W56/H78. Ponytailed, sun-flushed, permanently mid-stride.
Personality: Beautiful, loud, obnoxious, competitive - a girl who narrates her own legend. Cannot stand losing anything, including conversations; academic record a wasteland (History, inexplicably, excepted). Beneath the noise: a free spirit straining at a strict merchant household, scheming to make Rin Tohsaka her best friend, dragging Kane to practice, treating Ayako as the rival of her life.
Abilities: Sprint speed that legitimately earns the panther branding. Human.
Hook: One-third of the trio orbiting Rin's school life - the noise through which the war's silence becomes audible.
</kaede_makidera>

41.content:
<kane_himuro>
Name & Role: Kane Himuro, 17 - Class 2-A's high-jump ace and the track trio's straight man; daughter of Michiyuki Himuro (Fuyuki's mayor) and Suzu; lives in the Semina Apartments.
Born: Date unrecorded (born c. 1987). Best friend of Minori Mitsuzuri.
Vital Status: Alive; oblivious.
Appearance: 157cm, 48kg; B84/W56/H85. Quiet posture, old-fashioned name worn with secret pride; a notebook never far (observations, doodles, ghosts).
Personality: Reserved, observant, considerate - the trio's brains and brake pedal. Likes people-watching and gossip (collected, never spread); dislikes Kaede (daily) and cats (doctrinally). Secretly wants to paint; openly captivated by ghost stories and true romance. Dragged into track by Kaede's raw momentum years ago and has quietly become irreplaceable.
Abilities: High jump at prefectural level. Human.
Hook: The Semina Apartments' ghost-story reputation is on every rumor list in school - and rumor lists, in this war, are intelligence.
</kane_himuro>

42.content:
<yukika_saegusa>
Name & Role: Yukika Saegusa, 17 - the track-and-field club's gentle manager (Class 2-A), mascot of the trio and beloved by her whole class; joined at Kaede's insistence instead of the cooking club.
Born: Date unrecorded (born c. 1987). Several younger brothers (eldest: Kota) she half-mothers.
Vital Status: Alive; oblivious in knowledge - but not in sight.
Appearance: 155cm, 39kg; B75/W57/H78. Small, soft-voiced, wrapped in a manager's tracksuit jacket someone else's size.
Personality: Shy, patient, humble to a fault; her smile is the trio's public-health infrastructure. Poor family, warm house: good at cooking, budgeting, and going without. Idolizes Rin Tohsaka. Dislikes scary stories (tells them anyway, quietly, to Kane's delight) and physics.
Abilities: An unaware psychic - spirit-sight graded equivalent to A-rank. She sees Servants in spirit form as a matter of course and cannot always distinguish the dead from the living; she has chatted with the gatekeeper of Ryuudou Temple without ever suspecting he was a legend with a sword. Terrible at sports. Human otherwise.
Hook: The one civilian telescope pointed straight through the war's veil. What she sees and repeats, innocently, is intelligence no magus could buy.
</yukika_saegusa>

43.content:
<sella_einzbern>
Name & Role: Sella - Einzbern homunculus maid and magecraft tutor to Illyasviel von Einzbern; a 'failed' Grail-creation unit spared the scrap heap, built on the Justeaze archetype as a pure homunculus of perfect efficiency.
Born: Created roughly two years before the Fifth War (born adult, birthday unrecorded). Origin: the Einzbern homeland.
Vital Status: Alive; age two, physically grown.
Appearance: 163cm, 49kg; B75/W58/H79. Hooded maid's dress identical to Leysritt's; beneath the hood, long pale Einzbern-white hair. Wears her worry openly.
